basic_info.description: Modern sophistication, historic charm, leading edge location! This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft boasts soaring 19-foot ceilings, exposed brick walls and striking steel beams. Tucked into a tranquil corner of the building, this top floor unit features large windows and skylights that flood the home with natural light and offer leafy views of the newly renovated Esprit Park and the beautifully landscaped interior courtyard. Recent upgrades have elevated the space: stylish new lighting, fresh interior paint, refinished wood floors, refresh in both bathrooms, new fixtures/finishes throughout. The open concept layout seamlessly connects the kitchen with the living and dining areas. Add'l conveniences include: in unit washer/dryer, parking in a secured garage, elevator access to unit. Excellent location! Near UCSF Mission Bay; easy access to the 3rd Street rail and Hwy 280; close to Esprit Park and Crane Cove Park; a few blocks from the ground breaking waterfront project at Pier 70! Opening to the public for the 1st time in over a century, Pier 70 will feature an array of popular destinations, including Breadbelly Bakery, Standard Deviant Brewery, Bay Padel. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the nearby Blue Greenway - a stretch of land connecting 13 miles of walking/biking trails!
